title: Who's reading the code your AI writes?
partialText: AI makes you at least 30% faster on new code and 10% faster on old code. It also makes it easier to ship bugs, security flaws, and data leaks before anyone notices.

title: Design systems in an AI era; what changes when everyone can build?
partialText: Does a design system still belong in Figma? Do I still need a design system? Is Figma even still relevant in today's world as a designer?
